title: Arkham Horror: The Card Game
subtitle: A cooperative living card game of eldritch mystery and Lovecraftian dread
tagline: The truth lies in the shadows of Arkham
loreSummary: You are an investigator drawn into the shadowy depths of Arkham, Massachusetts, where ancient evils stir beneath the surface. Every card played, every clue uncovered, and every desperate decision pushes you deeper into the unraveling mystery.
keyFeatures: Living Card Game system — build and evolve your investigator's deck across the campaign
Persistent narrative consequences — choices in one scenario ripple through the entire cycle
Unique trauma and XP system — every defeat shapes your investigator's fate
Multiple named campaigns (cycles) to explore, each a standalone eldritch mystery
Solo and cooperative play for 1–4 investigators tackling Lovecraftian horrors

ahcg_core.name: Night of the Zealot (Core)
ahcg_core.description: The 3-scenario introductory campaign from the Core Set. A focused taste of Arkham's dark secrets, perfect for learning the game systems before committing to a full cycle.

ahcg_single_cycle.name: Single Full Cycle (~8 Scenarios)
ahcg_single_cycle.description: One complete campaign cycle (e.g. The Dunwich Legacy, Path to Carcosa, or The Forgotten Age) with roughly 8 scenarios. The recommended entry point for a full Arkham narrative experience.

ahcg_multi_cycle.name: Multiple Cycles (3 Cycles, ~24 Scenarios)
ahcg_multi_cycle.description: Three consecutive campaign cycles played back-to-back, allowing deep character progression across multiple named storylines and a rich evolving deck.

ahcg_full_collection.name: Full Collection (All Major Cycles, ~80 Scenarios)
ahcg_full_collection.description: All major campaign cycles in the Arkham Horror LCG collection — from Night of the Zealot through the latest releases — representing a complete Arkham Horror LCG journey spanning many months of play.

milestones.title: The First Revelation
milestones.description: Your investigators have uncovered the initial threads of the mystery, navigating Arkham's shadowy streets and surviving the first wave of eldritch horrors.

milestones.title: Deeper into the Mythos
milestones.description: The conspiracy runs deeper than anyone imagined. Your investigators press on, their decks honed by hard-won experience, as the Ancient One's influence grows ever stronger.

milestones.title: The Final Resolution
milestones.description: All paths converge as your investigators face the culmination of the campaign cycle. The final resolution will determine the fate of Arkham and the world beyond.
